scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd apps/backend && sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python manage.py runserver "$@"; else exec python3 manage.py runserver "$@"; fi' --
scripts.backend:check: cd apps/backend && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python manage.py check; else python3 manage.py check; fi
scripts.backend:migrate: cd apps/backend && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python manage.py migrate; else python3 manage.py migrate; fi
scripts.backend:test: cd apps/backend && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python manage.py test; else python3 manage.py test; fi
